================================================================
  SMELLY DIHH CLIENT - HOW TO RUN
================================================================

 1. RIGHT-CLICK the file "SMELLY-DIHH-CLIENT.zip" in your
    Downloads folder.
 2. Click "Extract All..." from the right-click menu.
 3. Pick a folder like C:\SmellyDihh\ and click Extract.
 4. OPEN the folder you just extracted into.
 5. DOUBLE-CLICK "ONE-CLICK.cmd"
    (if Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC",
     click "More info" then "Run anyway".)
 6. A black Command Prompt window will open with CYAN text
    and say "BUILD SUCCESSFUL!" when done (green text).
 7. Copy build\client-patched.jar into your Minecraft mods\
    folder, or run:
        java -jar build\client-patched.jar

  Press RIGHT_SHIFT in-game to open the ClickGUI.

 IF THE WINDOW FLASHES OPEN AND CLOSES
 -------------------------------------
     Double-click RUN-ME.vbs instead of ONE-CLICK.cmd.
     The .vbs file launches a fully persistent window that
     CANNOT close until you press a key.

 IF THERE IS AN ERROR IN RED TEXT
 --------------------------------
     Take a SCREENSHOT of the whole black window and send
     it, or attach BUILD-LOG.txt which is created in this
     folder after running.
================================================================
